body:
A top Apax Partners LLP dealmaker was driven by the unusual structure of its investment in Verint Systems Inc. to steer the software company into an underpriced $1.2 billion acquisition by Thoma Bravo LP, according to an unsealed lawsuit.

A shareholder cashed out by the transaction is suing former Verint board members including Jason Wright, who holds a senior role on Apax’s tech team, in Delaware’s Chancery Court. The suit says Wright sold out Verint’s public investors — exploiting turmoil related to President Donald Trump’s “Liberation Day” tariffs as a pretext — because Apax’s preferred stock would yield a fixed ...
